item.title: A message from the main office:
item.description: A reminder to staff and students that Monday, September 28th is school photo retakes in the morning on the stage. Wait for your grade to be called.

item.title: A message from: Mme Perron-
item.description: A Reminder to all Europe Travelers to please bring your items collected for the October 17th Trivia Night to Mme Perron as soon as possible. Also, please see the important message on teams page regarding passports. We will meet on Tuesday at lunch to continue planning Trivia Night.

item.title: A message from Mme. Plourde:
item.description: Bonne Journée Franco-Ontarienne à toutes et à tous! To all 7&8 students and teachers interested! We will be celebrating at 9:05 outside during recess.

item.title: A message from: Mrs. Kwok:
item.description: The next Unity Club meeting will take place on Monday at lunch in room 208. New members are always welcome!

item.title: A message from Mr. Vonesch:
item.description: Any high school students interested in helping out with the Thanksgiving Liturgy, either with readings, music, or helping out behind the scenes, please see Mr. Vonesch at the chapel today
